declarations.type:
∀ (principalAdmittedCount principalQuota : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.PrincipalQuotaAuthorized
      principalAdmittedCount principalQuota →
    principalAdmittedCount + 1 ≤ principalQuota
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.authorized_principal_admission_stays_within_quota

declarations.type:
∀ (proposedGlobalCapacity : Nat),
  ∃ principalCount principalQuota, proposedGlobalCapacity < principalCount ∧ principalQuota = 1
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.per_principal_quota_alone_does_not_bound_global_count

declarations.type:
∀ (admittedCount roundCapacity : Nat),
  admittedCount ≤ roundCapacity →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.ComparisonCount admittedCount ≤
      roundCapacity
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.comparison_count_is_bounded_by_round_capacity

declarations.type:
∀ (admittedCount roundCapacity fixedCost perComparisonCost : Nat),
  admittedCount ≤ roundCapacity →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.RoundProofCost admittedCount fixedCost
        perComparisonCost ≤
      fixedCost + roundCapacity * perComparisonCost
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.round_proof_cost_is_capacity_bounded

declarations.type:
∀ (attempts maximumAttempts admittedCount roundCapacity fixedCost perComparisonCost : Nat),
  attempts ≤ maximumAttempts →
    admittedCount ≤ roundCapacity →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.RecoveryProofCost attempts
          admittedCount fixedCost perComparisonCost ≤
        maximumAttempts * (fixedCost + roundCapacity * perComparisonCost)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.recovery_proof_cost_is_attempt_and_capacity_bounded

declarations.type:
∀
  (processedCount processingCapacity admittedCount admissionCapacity fixedCost perRegistrationCost perComparisonCost :
    Nat),
  processedCount ≤ processingCapacity →
    admittedCount ≤ admissionCapacity →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.RoundSearchCost processedCount
          admittedCount fixedCost perRegistrationCost perComparisonCost ≤
        fixedCost + processingCapacity * perRegistrationCost + admissionCapacity * perComparisonCost
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.round_search_cost_is_dual_capacity_bounded

declarations.type:
∀
  (attempts maximumAttempts processedCount processingCapacity admittedCount admissionCapacity fixedCost
    perRegistrationCost perComparisonCost : Nat),
  attempts ≤ maximumAttempts →
    processedCount ≤ processingCapacity →
      admittedCount ≤ admissionCapacity →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.RecoverySearchCost attempts
            processedCount admittedCount fixedCost perRegistrationCost perComparisonCost ≤
          maximumAttempts *
            (fixedCost + processingCapacity * perRegistrationCost + admissionCapacity * perComparisonCost)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.recovery_search_cost_is_globally_bounded

declarations.type:
∀ {TransitionId CandidateSetDigest PolicyId CostModelId : Type}
  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.AdmissionRoundKey TransitionId
      CandidateSetDigest PolicyId CostModelId),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.AdmissionRoundCompatible left right →
    left.roundCapacity = right.roundCapacity
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.admission_round_compatibility_binds_capacity

declarations.type:
∀ {TransitionId CandidateSetDigest PolicyId CostModelId : Type}
  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.AdmissionRoundKey TransitionId
      CandidateSetDigest PolicyId CostModelId),
  left.roundCapacity ≠ right.roundCapacity →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.AdmissionRoundCompatible left right
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedCandidateAdmissionCost.changed_capacity_invalidates_admission_round

      CandidateSetDigest PolicyId CostModelId)
